title: Cobblemon: Synergised
description: This modpack aims to enhance the cobblemon experience using other mods that synergise well with it.
body:
# <center>Overview
**Cobblemon:Synergised** aims to mix the cobblemon experience with other mods that synergise well with it and/or add additional complementary content to it. Such as Terralith, Nature's Compass, Sophisticated backpacks and more.

## Bigger World
- **Terralith**'s enhanced world generation.
- Find any pokemon's home with **Nature's Compass**.
- Expand your horizons(haha) with **Distant Horizons**.

## All the pokemon
- Find your favorite legendaries with **Legendary Monuments**
- Several QoL cobblemon addons are added like **Pokenav**, **Safe Pastures** etc
- **Cobblemon: Integration** adds compat with **Serene Seasons** and **Enhanced Celestials**

<details>
<summary>Future Plans</summary>
- Add a custom rct series for a better singleplayer experience
</details>
